audit_scope: Read-only Git history, ignore rules, README/AGENTS/plan/index path references. No project file or Git index changes.

findings.problem: The Windows snapshot policy was overwritten by the WSL workbench .gitignore. Patterns *.*, *, and explicit dependency-directory exclusions ignore almost all new source, ECC run, and verification files. Existing tracked paths still update, hiding the error in ordinary git status.
evidence: git diff e/e7/.gitignore shows full replacement of snapshot policy
git check-ignore -v attributes diagnostic_comparison.json in both ecc and verification to e/e7/.gitignore:2:*
findings.recommendation: Do not treat WSL workbench VCS ownership rules as the Windows publication policy. Preserve exact WSL source files when mirroring, but stage the audited manifest explicitly with git add -f and verify its complete staged path set, or keep a clearly documented Windows-only ignore overlay. Avoid broad directory ignores for ecc because project inputs and runs must remain publishable.

findings.problem: These are artificial alternate mappings of WSL ecc/npc and ecc/npc-e7. They replace the original layout with partial file subsets and led to a missing diagnostic run at its expected Windows path.
findings.recommendation: Copy full project/run trees at ecc/npc and ecc/npc-e7 first, hash verify, then remove duplicate mappings only after proving no unique content. Preserve verification as an additional copy, never the sole source-layout snapshot.

findings.path: e/e7/README.md:116; e/e7/E7学习计划.md:766,958; e/测试与构建入口索引.md:158
findings.problem: Current guidance points to synthesis/ecc-* or synthesis/ rather than ecc/... as the real snapshot path.
findings.recommendation: Update current guidance to ecc/npc-e7 and ecc/npc; do not rewrite dated historical validation into new tests. Diagnostic result source-layout location should be primary, verification copy secondary.

findings.problem: 1184 selected files were verified, not a full WSL source tree. This cannot support a complete-sync claim. Current top paragraph still describes the older Nov4 snapshot.
findings.recommendation: Replace current snapshot counts with results of the full new audit, name explicit excluded tool/cache/build paths, and keep excluded files inventoried. Old dated statements may remain historical.

findings.problem: The canonical WSL root README is a 227-byte course initializer, while the same Windows path contains the stage guide. A naive full mirror would destroy the guide; keeping it silently is not byte-identical mirroring.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the existing stage guide under a clearly named stage-only documentation path and update AGENTS links if the source root README is to be mirrored exactly. Alternative: explicitly declare README.md as a Windows-only overlay and include its source conflict in the audit. Do not silently overwrite or invent source equivalence.

findings.problem: Nested original ignore rules also suppress new dependency files. Restoring only the top stage ignore does not guarantee completeness.
findings.recommendation: Use full audited source/run manifest for scoped forced staging and audit its staged set; retain nested .git directories excluded. Do not recursively force-add unclassified artifacts or secrets.

findings.problem: The blanket statement that raw waves and build outputs are not synchronized conflicts with the latest user request to keep relevant test outputs at original paths.
findings.recommendation: Separate source sync policy from Git publication and clearly allow relevant tests/reports/waves in original paths; only exclude actual tool installs, caches, and transient compiler outputs where appropriate.

already_present.description: ecc/npc-e7/Makefile,ecc.toml,rtl/filelist.f and the existing area/balance/e7-syn-sta-01 runs are tracked at original paths; do not delete these as duplicates.

git_scope.ignore_note: Root policy intentionally excludes local learning plans/background/handoff documents; do not accidentally force-stage those. User asked repository submission but preserve unrelated working tree changes.

line_endings.recommendation: Hash synchronization bytes before stage and review normalization effects; do not alter the historical backup attributes or force existing symlinks into incorrect source bytes.

learning_record_instruction: Do not add synchronization maintenance activity to E7学习记录.md; use README or a dedicated synchronization audit artifact.
